items.name: ordering_from_parquet_metadata
items.summary: Extracts ordering information from Parquet metadata.

items.name: DFParquetMetadata
items.summary: Handles fetching Parquet file schema, metadata and statistics from object store.

methods.name: fetch_schema
methods.summary: Fetch this file's [`ParquetMetaData`] and convert its embedded Thrift schema into an Arrow [`Schema`].

methods.name: fetch_statistics
methods.summary: Fetch the metadata from the Parquet file via [`Self::fetch_metadata`] and convert the statistics in the metadata using [`Self::statistics_from_parquet_metadata`]

methods.name: new
methods.signature: fn new(store: &'a dyn ObjectStore, object_meta: &'a ObjectMeta) -> Self
methods.summary: Create a new `DFParquetMetadata` for the given file.

methods.name: with_coerce_int96
methods.summary: Set the [`TimeUnit`] that INT96 timestamp columns should be coerced to when reading the schema.

methods.name: with_coerce_int96_tz
methods.summary: Set the optional timezone applied to INT96-coerced timestamps.

methods.name: with_decryption_properties
methods.summary: Set the decryption properties used to read an encrypted Parquet file, equivalent to [`ParquetMetaDataReader::with_decryption_properties`].

methods.name: with_file_metadata_cache
methods.summary: Set an optional [`FileMetadataCache`] used to avoid re-fetching [`ParquetMetaData`] for files that have already been read.

methods.name: with_metadata_size_hint
methods.summary: Set a hint for the number of trailing bytes to prefetch from the end of the file, equivalent to [`ParquetMetaDataReader::with_prefetch_hint`].

methods.name: with_page_index_policy
methods.summary: Sets the policy for loading parquet page index structures (column and offset indexes), equivalent to [`ParquetMetaDataReader::with_page_index_policy`].
